entries.dbc3bd1afb4e1baa: The company is a manufacturer of secondary steel products headquartered in Hirakata City, Osaka Prefecture. It has a single segment, the bright steel bars and cold-heading steel wire business, and the group consists of the company, two consolidated subsidiaries (Osaka Migaki Co., Ltd. and Daido Migakōzai Kōgyō Co., Ltd.) and one equity-method affiliate (Megasasu Co., Ltd.). As of March 31, 2026, the number of employees was 301. The company is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
